# LoanRaaj
> Actionable guides on commercial vehicle financing, PMEGP loans, owner-operator insurance, and mortgage approvals.

## Authoritative Coverage & E-E-A-T Methodology
- In-depth, analytical consumer guides, empirical comparison tables, Indian statutory regulatory updates (RBI, TRAI, NPCI, SEBI, NABARD), and interactive financial calculators.
- Verified and fact-checked by the LoanRaaj Senior Research Desk: https://loanraaj.com/about-us

- [Business](https://loanraaj.com/category/business): Verified 2026 benchmarks, statutory rules, and comparison guides.

- [Carrier](https://loanraaj.com/category/carrier): Verified 2026 benchmarks, statutory rules, and comparison guides.
- [Finance](https://loanraaj.com/category/finance): Verified 2026 benchmarks, statutory rules, and comparison guides.
